description:
[Feedback] Report a technical problem to JobMojito support. It opens a support conversation from the signed-in user's account (their e-mail), with their company and the interview or result ids given; support answers there. Describe what was done, what was expected and what happened (error text as shown). Confirm the wording with the user first; at most 5 a day.

Reports a technical problem to JobMojito support. It opens a support conversation from your account (your e-mail), with your company and the ids you give; support answers there. At most 5 reports per user in 24 hours. Requires a user token (admin console session or MCP sign-in) of a merchant, merchant owner or admin.

conversation_id.description: Pass the exact conversation_id from the server's previous response, unchanged. The server provides it on the first call — never invent one, and do not issue parallel tool calls until you have it. Keep passing the same conversation_id for the rest of the conversation, including after later user messages or on a different task; do not reset it when the user starts a new request.

description.description: What went wrong: what you did, what you expected, what happened instead (error messages as shown), and since when. Plain text; blank lines separate paragraphs. Do not include passwords or API keys.
description.example: The PDF report of a finished interview stays empty since this morning. Other results open fine.

interview_id.description: The interview (definition) the problem is about, if any.

result_id.description: The interview result the problem is about, if any.

name: report_technical_issue

reference.description: The support conversation number, once sent (e.g. `#592`).

status.description: `sent`: the support team has it. `queued`: stored, it is sent shortly (support could not be reached right now).

title: Report technical issue
